extracted_concepts.name: Limit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Behavior of a function as input approaches a specific value

extracted_concepts.name: Continuity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function is continuous at a if limit equals function value at point

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Instantaneous rate of change defined by limit of difference quotient

extracted_concepts.name: Squeeze Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If g(x) ≤ f(x) ≤ h(x) and outer limits match, inner limit equals same value

extracted_concepts.name: Chain Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of composite function equals outer derivative times inner derivative

extracted_concepts.name: Product Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of product fg' = f'g + fg'

extracted_concepts.name: Quotient Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of quotient (f/g)' = (f'g - fg')/g²

extracted_concepts.name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Relates differentiation and integration, derivative of accumulation function is original function

extracted_concepts.name: Mean Value Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Some point c has instantaneous rate equal to average rate over interval

extracted_concepts.name: Extreme Value Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Continuous function on closed interval attains absolute maximum and minimum

extracted_concepts.name: Riemann Sum
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Approximation of area under curve using sum of rectangular areas

extracted_concepts.name: Definite Integral
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Limit of Riemann sums representing net accumulation or signed area

extracted_concepts.name: Related Rates
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Method relating time derivatives of interconnected variables

extracted_concepts.name: Linearization
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Local linear approximation L(x) = f(a) + f'(a)(x-a)

extracted_concepts.name: L'Hospital's Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Evaluates indeterminate limits 0/0 or ∞/∞ by taking ratio of derivatives

extracted_concepts.name: Separation of Variables
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Solving ODEs by isolating variable terms and integrating both sides

extracted_concepts.name: Slope Field
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Visual grid showing derivative slopes dy/dx at various points

extracted_concepts.name: Taylor Polynomial
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Polynomial approximation Pₙ(x) constructed from function derivatives at a point

extracted_concepts.name: Geometric Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Infinite sum Σarⁿ converges to a/(1-r) when |r| < 1

extracted_concepts.name: Ratio Test
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Determines convergence using limit of absolute ratio of consecutive terms

extracted_concepts.name: Concavity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Curvature direction determined by sign of second derivative

extracted_concepts.name: Critical Point
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Point where derivative is zero or undefined, candidate for extrema

extracted_concepts.name: Implicit Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Differentiating equations not explicitly solved for dependent variable

extracted_concepts.name: Inverse Function Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of inverse function is reciprocal of derivative at corresponding point

extracted_concepts.name: Newton's Method
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Iterative root-finding algorithm using tangent line approximations

extracted_concepts.name: Polar Coordinates
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Coordinate system specifying position by radius and angle

extracted_concepts.name: Arc Length
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Distance along a curve calculated via integral of speed or derivative magnitude

extracted_concepts.name: Volume of Revolution
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Volume generated by rotating a planar region around an axis

extracted_concepts.name: Alternating Series Test
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Series converges if absolute terms decrease monotonically to zero

extracted_concepts.name: Infinite Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sum of infinitely many terms, analyzed for convergence or divergence

extracted_concepts.name: Parametric Equations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Functions x=f(t), y=g(t) defining coordinates via independent parameter

extracted_concepts.name: Differential Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Equation relating a function to its derivatives, modeling dynamic systems
